added.title: Data Engineer II, AWS DC Global Network Delivery
added.description:
Description

AWS Global Network Delivery Services keeps the cloud running. We own the delivery and operation of all AWS global infrastructure — every data center, every server, every cable that gives hundreds of millions of customers uninterrupted access to the services they depend on. We tackle some of the hardest supply chain and infrastructure problems on the planet, with thousands of variables in play, and we're looking for exceptional people to help solve them.

You'll join a diverse, cross-functional team — Product, BI, network engineers, planners, builders, and operations leaders worldwide — collaborating across AWS to deliver the highest standards of safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost. You'll work in an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We're seeking a talented Data Engineer who thrives with a startup mentality — someone who moves fast, thinks big, and partners directly with business and senior leaders to turn ambiguous problems into clear, data-backed recommendations.

What makes this role exciting? You won't just move data from point A to point B — you'll build context through your pipelines. You'll own the context-driven source-of-truth tables that track the infrastructure delivery process across its full lifecycle — from intake through deployment to decommission — fueling analytics, LLMs, and business decisions. You'll manage the infrastructure behind those pipelines, keeping it lightweight, auditable, and highly available. And you'll partner closely with Data Engineering, Product, and Software teams to design pipelines that let business teams answer their own questions — without waiting in a queue.

The ideal candidate is passionate about understanding the business and making an impact with data. You ask sharp questions, design thoughtful data models, and build relevant pipelines with low tech debt. You know great data engineering isn't about shipping pipeline after pipeline — it's about data quality, governance, and knowing your sources well enough to make the right trade-offs. You'll build well-documented, context-rich datasets and self-service tools (new or reused) that put data directly in the hands of the people who need it most — applying data mining, data modeling, and AI to evaluate business health and drive measurable improvement..

Key job responsibilities

Know why you're building, not just what. Ask sharp questions first, understand your data and its significance, reuse before you rebuild, and set clear data contracts so data is always traceable to its source — and correct.
Own the design, development, and operation of scalable, production-grade, context-driven data pipelines — including the infrastructure behind them — keeping them lightweight, cost-efficient, auditable, and highly available to power metrics, reporting, analytics, and ML/LLM use cases.
Build context-rich "source of truth" datasets and reusable, dimensional data models that track the infrastructure delivery lifecycle (intake → deployment → decommission), serving as a trusted, intuitive-to-query foundation for downstream consumers while keeping tech debt in check.
Design data models and ETL/ELT workflows to ingest, transform, and integrate data from diverse sources using AWS services (e.g., S3, Redshift, Glue, EMR, Athena, Lambda) and internal Amazon data platform tools.
Define and champion data quality/ engineering and governance best practices — validation, monitoring/alerting, testing, design standards, documentation, and governance — to keep pipelines accurate, trustworthy, and well-maintained.
Partner with Software, Product, and other Data Engineering teams to source and model the right business entities, so any team can answer their own questions without waiting in a queue.
Troubleshoot operational and data-quality issues with root-cause analysis and durable fixes; audit existing pipelines, jobs, and queries, and recommend improvements to upstream sources for greater accuracy, simplicity, and scalability

About The Team

We are the PAX Data and Analytics team — a small, high-conviction group of BI Engineers and Data Engineers embedded in one of the world's largest and fastest-growing data center organizations. We were established less than a year ago with a clear mandate: **turn operational complexity into decision-ready clarity.**

We don't build data pipelines and dashboards . We build *context* — the kind that lets leaders act with confidence and operators spot problems before they become incidents. Our work spans the full data lifecycle: sourcing and integrating raw operational signals, engineering relevant and reliable pipelines, and surfacing insights through self-service tools that hundreds of people rely on daily.

Every pipeline we ship, every standard we define, and every contract we establish becomes the foundation for what comes next

We are young, we are scrappy, and we are building something that will outlast us. If you want to lay foundations that an entire organization will stand on — you're in the right place.

Basic Qualifications

4+ years of data engineering experience
Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related field
Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
Experience in at least one modern scripting or programming language, such as Python, Java, Scala, or NodeJS
Experience with SQL
Experience working on and delivering end to end projects independently

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases)
Knowledge of batch and streaming data architectures like Kafka, Kinesis, Flink, Storm, Beam

Establish and enforce data quality standards and governance practices to ensure the integrity and reliability of our data assets.

.

Proven ability to design and build scalable and resilient data systems from scratch.

Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to a variety of audiences.

Experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science / Engineering

added.title: Sr. Data Platform Engineer
added.description:
Scion Staffing has been engaged to conduct a search for a Senior Data Platform Engineer for our partner, an established healthcare services organization modernizing its technology and data capabilities. This is a direct hire, on onsite position located in Addison, Texas.

Position Overview

The Senior Data Platform Engineer will build, operate, and secure a modern Snowflake data platform using a medallion architecture. Working closely with the Data Architect, this hands-on engineer will develop ingestion pipelines, dbt transformations, dimensional models, and governance controls that turn sensitive operational data into trusted business insights. This high-ownership opportunity is ideal for someone who enjoys managing the full data lifecycle and helping shape a growing data environment.

Perks

Employee benefits package, with complete details to be provided during the interview process
High-impact opportunity to help build and shape a modern enterprise data platform
Broad ownership across Snowflake, dbt, data modeling, governance, security, and pipeline development
Collaborative environment with opportunities to mentor teammates and expand modern data-stack capabilities

Responsibilities

Onboard data from SQL Server databases and SaaS applications through REST APIs, ODBC, SFTP, file feeds, native connectors, incremental-loading methods, and CDC patterns.
Build, maintain, and monitor pipelines across the bronze, silver, and gold layers using Snowflake, dbt, SQL, Python, Azure Data Factory, and modern orchestration tools.
Develop dimensional data models, including fact and dimension tables, appropriate grain, conformed dimensions, and slowly changing dimensions, while translating business requirements into maintainable transformations.
Manage the Snowflake environment, including warehouses, roles, resource monitors, platform performance, cost management, reliability, scheduling, dependencies, and failure resolution.
Protect PHI, PII, and other sensitive data by implementing RBAC, least-privilege access, masking, row-access policies, audit logging, lineage, and governance controls.
Establish data-quality tests, validation checks, source-to-warehouse reconciliation, and consistent business definitions while serving as a hands-on technical resource to other engineers.

Qualifications

Minimum of 5 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a closely related role.
Advanced SQL skills and hands-on experience designing dimensional data models, including fact tables, dimension tables, grain, conformed dimensions, and slowly changing dimensions.
Production experience with dbt, medallion architecture, modern ELT patterns, and a cloud data warehouse; Snowflake experience is strongly preferred.
Experience building ingestion pipelines from both SQL databases and SaaS or API-based sources using REST APIs, ODBC, SFTP, file feeds, native connectors, incremental loading, or CDC.
Proficiency with Python and experience with orchestration or integration technologies such as Azure Data Factory, Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, Snowpipe, Streams and Tasks, or Snowflake Openflow.
Experience implementing access and security controls for sensitive or regulated data, including RBAC, data masking, row-level access, audit logging, or comparable protections.
Demonstrated ability to independently own a production data platform within a small team, including pipeline reliability, monitoring, troubleshooting, data quality, security, performance, and cost management; healthcare, revenue cycle management, HIPAA/PHI, NetSuite, Paycom, Power BI, or SnowPro experience is preferred.

Compensation And Benefits

This position offers competitive compensation salary range of $135-145k/yr (DOE) and an employee benefits package. Compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, technical expertise, certifications, and other job-related qualifications.

Experience managing backend infrastructure and distributed data pipelines.
Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.

Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
3 years of experience in a role preparing and delivering technical presentations to senior leadership.
2 years of experience in software development or engineering.
2 years of experience working cross-functionally with engineering, UX/UI, sales finance, and other stakeholders.
1 year of experience in technical leadership.
Experience launching developer-facing tools, APIs, or system-level infrastructure frameworks.

About The Job

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

Autonomous AI agents are fundamentally bounded by the capabilities of the data engines beneath them. As a Product Manager for critical AI Foundations Data engineering infrastructure, you will be in a unique position to own emerging pipeline technologies required to scale Google's AI infrastructure. Based in San Jose, CA, you will provide a vital local presence, co-located with the engineering teams building cutting edge data pipeline technologies, while actively partnering with key AI-First teams and DeepMind researchers to accelerate model speed-to-market.

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

added.title: Automation Engineer
added.description:
Description

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. The Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) team are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all of the robotics and material handling equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About The Role

As an Automation Engineer, you will play a crucial role in maximizing equipment reliability and operational performance in our fulfillment centers by providing proactive controls automation and technical support. Your expertise will be essential in troubleshooting complex control systems, analyzing performance metrics, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize material handling equipment (MHE) systems and implement innovative projects. You'll work with state-of-the-art technology, including conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print and apply systems, and SCADA devices and programs. Through your efforts, you'll directly contribute to ensuring our customers receive their orders with Amazon's signature speed and accuracy.

What Do We Offer?

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there’s more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Key job responsibilities

Key Job Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To

You will serve as the site expert for maintaining the automation systems that are critical for operations
You will understand, maintain and troubleshoot material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers and industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems
You will monitor MHE metrics and partner with maintenance/operations to address system performance issues and provide analysis across all operations
You will provide first-level escalation support for site technicians, both locally and remotely
You will perform and analyze building System Assessments to enhance material handling system performance

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent, or 2+ years of PLC programming or automation engineering experience
Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent, or 2+ years of process or production environment related PLC-controlled automation and issue diagnosis experience
Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent, or 2+ years of robotics work cells and control systems experience
Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent, or 2+ years of electrical theory, robotics, controls components, and automated equipment experience
Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent, or 2+ years of Ladder Logic and structured programming from Siemens, Allen-Bradley, or Codesys PLCs experience

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with HMI and control network components, including maintenance, troubleshooting, programming and design
Experience identifying, maintaining, and troubleshooting Motor Controls including motor starters, Variable Frequency Drives, DC drives, and standard electrical components
Experience with preventive maintenance procedures, industrial electrical, industrial controls, and industrial electronics & robotics
Experience interpreting, modifying, and developing mechanical and electrical drawings
Experience programming with RSLogix5000, Studio 5000, FT View, and other controls software platforms
